charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Primary headings, high-emphasis text — the deepest ink against the warm white canvas, anchoring headlines at maximum contrast

graphite.$description: Graphite — Body text, icon strokes, secondary headings — slightly lighter than Charcoal for body density where pure black feels too heavy

mid-ink.$description: Mid Ink — Filled button background, dark UI surfaces, strong border emphasis — the primary action surface; charcoal-darker than body text for weight contrast against pills

steel.$description: Steel — Default border color, card edges, icon strokes at rest — the structural hairline that carries the entire layout; appears in 260 borderColor uses, making it the most-used stroke in the system

fog.$description: Fog — Muted secondary borders, low-emphasis dividers — a lighter hairline for de-emphasized structure

ash.$description: Ash — Card inner borders, subtle dividers inside containers — softer than Steel for nested elements

slate.$description: Slate — Disabled or inactive border state, decorative dividers — sits between Steel and Fog for tertiary structural lines

mist.$description: Mist — Subtle shadow contribution, light card shadow base — a desaturated mid-gray for soft elevation

silk.$description: Silk — Image borders, body content dividers, light surface separators — the lightest visible structural line, near-white with just enough definition

bone.$description: Bone — Page canvas, card surfaces, link border, light text on dark — the warm white foundation; every other neutral reads against this base

cream.$description: Cream — Secondary button fill, elevated surface tone, subtle hover state — one step warmer/lighter than Bone for nested surfaces

aspekta.$description: All UI text — headlines at 40-56px use weight 400 with aggressive negative tracking (-0.035em to -0.020em) to create a condensed, modern feel; body text at 16-18px uses weight 400 with lighter tracking (-0.011em to -0.010em); weight 500 reserved for button labels and emphasis. The tight letter-spacing at display sizes is signature — it pulls letters together so headlines read as confident blocks rather than airy sentences.

fasthand.$description: Handwritten accent for emotional kickers and signatures — the 'Listen!' above the hero headline, the 'Open Letter' section intro. One weight, one size, used at most once per section. This is the human voice in an otherwise architectural system; it appears only where the brand needs warmth over precision.

aspekta-500.$description: Aspekta 500 — detected in extracted data but not described by AI
